title: Nothing sits still: continuous motion with layered fake-3D depth
principle: The Kurzgesagt school of motion design keeps every element alive — overlapping action, exaggerated eased movement, and fake-3D depth (foreground/midground/background parallax) — so frames read as a living scene rather than a slide.
rule: Every scene must show measurable pixel change across its duration (static-scene detection over Gate-B stills blocks at the ship gate), and compositions should layer depth: background drift + midground subject + foreground accents.

source.name: Kurzgesagt — Motion Graphics with Kurzgesagt (Skillshare, parts 1-3: key poses, fake 3D depth, exaggerated movement, overlapping action)
